description: Paid, $0.02 USDC on Base via x402. x402 category demand depth for one API category: summary (probes, agent_probes, conversions), price points probed and a daily series. The category must be one publishers report (get_intent_trends lists categories that have data); a category with no reported traffic in the window answers 404 no_data and is not charged. Without WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, returns the x402 payment challenge instead of settling.

category.description: Category as reported by publishers, e.g. blockchain, developer-tools (get_intent_trends lists categories with data)

name: get_category_demand
